note: Ground-truth catalog for the T1-05 node-type vocabulary compliance check. The membership validator (diagram_checks._node_type_checks) accepts any token in `types` (name or alias) or `styling_classes`; a token outside the catalog is flagged with a fuzzy-match suggestion. `unknown`/`other` are first-class passing members so typing is never coerced. Aliases fold the incumbent Mermaid classDef names + the D2 POC class names onto the same permissive type set. The `icon` field is the vendored local SVG path (relative to this references/ dir); the D2 path binds it into a `classes` block (d2-spec.md §2/§3), the Mermaid path via `@{shape: icon}` (mermaid-spec.md §3).
